title: Device view showing from 1 to 48 devices | VirtualPyTest
description:
The Device view now shows from 1 to 48 devices. Its View menu picks 12, 24 or 48 live devices per page, or a layout that fits the screen: side by side, a 2×2 grid, or one stream on the whole page. Click any stream to open it in big, close it and you are back to your layout.

Shown on 24 HLS test streams. Big Buck Bunny and Tears of Steel, (CC) Blender Foundation, CC BY 3.0.

Open source & free
